## Endpoints

### Data Write (3)
- `POST /v1/p` — Submit data to Crunchbase via the v1/p endpoint.
- `POST /wa` — Submit data to Crunchbase via the /wa endpoint.
- `POST /webevents/visitwebpage` — Report a webpage visit event to Crunchbase.

### Media (2)
- `GET /image/upload/{id}/{c_pad,w_1000,f_auto,b_white,q_auto:eco,dpr_1Id}` — Retrieve a specific image with transformations from Crunchbase.
- `GET /image/upload/{uploadId}` — Get an image from Crunchbase using its upload ID.

## Quick Start

### OpenClaw (Unbrowse) workflow
- Authenticate in the browser first (no credentials are shipped with this skill).
- Capture fresh auth locally: run `unbrowse_capture` on an authenticated page for this domain.
- Execute via backend gate + client browser executor: `unbrowse_replay` with `executionMode="backend"`.

Example:
```text
unbrowse_replay { service: "crunchbase", executionMode: "backend", endpoint: "POST /v1/p" }
```

Here's a Quick Start to get you up and running with the Crunchbase API:

```typescript
// Submit data to Crunchbase using the /wa endpoint.
async function submitData(data: any) {
  try {
    const response = await client.wa(data);
    console.log("Data submission successful:", response);
    return response;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error submitting data:", error);
    throw error;
  }
}
```

```typescript
// Retrieve a transformed image from Crunchbase.
async function getImage(id: string) {
  try {
    const imageUrl = await client.image.upload[id].c_pad.w_1000.f_auto.b_white.q_auto_eco.dpr_1Id();
    console.log("Image URL:", imageUrl);
    return imageUrl;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Error retrieving image:", error);
    throw error;
  }
}
```

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Crunchbase's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Crunchbase data without official API access
- Automate actions on www.crunchbase.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Crunchbase frontend uses
